description: Bloatware lists for Oppo, OnePlus, and Realme devices (OPlus/HeyTap codebase). Updated for ColorOS 16, Realme UI 7.0, and OxygenOS 16 (Android 16).

light: These packages are safe to remove on all OPlus devices (ColorOS 11+, OxygenOS 11+, Realme UI 2.0+).
Always create a backup before removing anything.
If a package is not present on your device, it will be skipped automatically.
aggressive: Read each description carefully. Some packages affect specific features.
Use 'disable' instead of 'uninstall' for packages you might want back later.
Always create a backup before proceeding.
Some packages like com.oplus.pantanal.ums, com.oplus.dfs, and com.oplus.eid are borderline. Test them one at a time with a backup.
blacklist: The app will prevent you from selecting these packages.
If you accidentally remove one, use ADB to restore it: adb shell cmd package install-existing <package_name>.
Some packages may require root to remove, but they should never be removed anyway.
coloros_16_specific: ColorOS 16 has introduced stricter protection on certain system packages. Standard adb shell pm uninstall or disable-user commands may throw a SecurityException: Access denied error for some packages.
Packages like com.heytap.quicksearchbox, com.coloros.assistantscreen, com.heytap.browser, and com.heytap.pictorial may require root (Magisk/KernelSU) to be removed on ColorOS 16 China ROM.
For these stubborn packages, use 'suspend' or 'disable' commands if available. If not, they must be left alone.
oneplus_15_and_newer: On OnePlus 15 (CPH2749, ColorOS V16) and similar new devices, specific privacy and telemetry packages have been identified and tested by the community.
The aggressive list includes these packages (com.oplus.pantanal.ums, com.oplus.nas, etc.) and they have been verified as safe to disable on these specific models.
Always verify on your specific device model before proceeding.
